purpose: Allow sideways consolidation and delayed confirmation without any fixed candle-count expiry; evaluate all 10 original indicators separately on 1D and 4H.
signal_parameters: Unchanged original Close/Regular/pivot5/maxpp10/maxbars100/wait for confirmation. No signal-parameter optimization.
structure_window: For signal confirmation bar t and saved divergence length L, p=t-L is the previously confirmed price pivot. Freeze high=max(high[p:t+1]) and low=min(low[p:t+1]), inclusive of the confirmation bar. This is an operational structure box, not an independently validated chart-pattern definition.
bullish: SUCCESS on first subsequent native-timeframe CLOSE > frozen high. FAILURE on first subsequent CLOSE < frozen low - 0.5*ATR14_at_signal. Wicks alone do not resolve the event.
bearish: SUCCESS on first subsequent native-timeframe CLOSE < frozen low. FAILURE on first subsequent CLOSE > frozen high + 0.5*ATR14_at_signal.
reference_price: Signal confirmation close. No trade execution, fees, funding or portfolio return are inferred.
event_lifecycle: One active event per indicator and timeframe, shared by both directions. New signals before resolution are logged but ignored. A signal on the resolving close can open the next event, observed from the next bar. No event is retrospectively replaced by a later, better pivot.
right_censoring: No artificial duration timeout. Still active at each data-period end is PENDING, not failure or success. Each period restarts event tracking using past data for indicator warmup. Rates across periods must not be pooled.
data_quality: Reject a new event whose frozen structure interval includes a known native/hourly OHLC-inconsistent bar. If an active event reaches such a bar, classify DATA_INTERRUPTED and do not score it. Keep full records. Native-timeframe closes define both outcomes; hourly intrabar chronology is not used.
metrics: success/all eligible events and upper bound if all pending succeed
Wilson descriptive interval on completed events
successes occurring later than the prior 10D/3D windows
interpretation: Confirmation means the frozen structure boundary was closed through; it does not promise a lasting new trend. Different box widths and unequal confirmation/failure distances affect event success rates, so they are reported. The new definition changes BOTH the time restriction and the price-failure criterion; improvements cannot be attributed to time alone.
scope: 20 primary settings and earlier/recent diagnostics only. No combinations, no ATR-buffer optimization, no extra filters, no causal edge claim.
pending_external_checks: TradingView per-bar reconciliation and genuinely future validation remain incomplete.
